# PsySH

PsySH is a runtime developer console, interactive debugger and [REPL](https://example.invalid/wiki/Read%E2%80%93eval%E2%80%93print_loop) for PHP. Learn more at [example.invalid](http://example.invalid/) and [in the manual](https://example.invalid/bobthecow/psysh/wiki/Home).
